tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything; also the sunken ground of inputs inside a card (Edit word).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, list cards, secondary buttons, round header buttons, the flashcard.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Icon wells (44 px squares), pressed state of cards and rows, the photo thumbnail ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Pills and chips on a card (part of speech, count pills, Skip state), the status select, Retry/Retake, and every disabled primary button.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: All primary text. On bg 17.2:1 / 17.5:1, on surface 18.9:1 / 16.2:1, on surface-raised 14.9:1 / 13.9:1. Also the fill of the active segmented tab (with bg as its text).

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text that must still read as content: the delete confirmation's explanation, the 'already in your words' list. In code: color-mix(text 50%, muted).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, translations under a headword, labels, counts, hints, chevrons. On bg 5.8:1 / 7:1, on surface 6.4:1 / 6.5:1, on surface-raised 5:1 / 5.6:1.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1 px hairline on cards, tiles and the search field; dividers under list rows; the sticky footer's top edge.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of every progress bar, streak dot and streak segment; the 48 px divider on the card back; the border of inputs sunk into a card.

tokens.name: track-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed outlines of add targets (New import tile, the drop zone, Add more photos), the Skip swipe edge, the skipped share of the results bar. In code: color-mix(muted 35%, transparent).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lime, as a FILL only: the one main action (Practice, Start, Save N words, Knew it, Add), the speaker button, the drop-zone icon square, the selected source's icon well. Never as text, icon or thin mark on a light ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: 14.6:1 (7.2:1 at 75% opacity, Practice's second line).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: The accent as text, icon, outline or small mark: focus rings, quiet buttons, filled progress (bars, dots, segments), the selected-source border, a photo read. Light 6.3:1 on bg, 5.1:1 against track; dark 15.4:1 on bg, 11.4:1 against track.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the NEW pill, under accent-ink text (6.2:1 light, 10.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done state of Add details (PendingDetails).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground for a success message.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: A source note Wiktionary disagrees with, a poor-quality photo, the article-mismatch strip text and its Use button fill.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the article-mismatch strip on a Review card; Details pending pill on the card back.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a warning fill (Use das).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Didn't know (button text, stamp fill, results-bar share), Delete, error text, a failed photo.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill: 5.4:1 light, 6:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of Didn't know and Delete word buttons, the delete confirmation, error boxes. danger text on it is at least 4.5:1.

tokens.name: der
tokens.usage: Masculine article as text (der), its example word, its chip; also the Learning dot on Home. On bg 5.9:1 / 8.1:1, on surface 6.5:1 / 7.5:1.

tokens.name: der-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the DER · MASCULINE chip on Word detail (der text on it 5.4:1 / 5.9:1).

tokens.name: die
tokens.usage: Feminine (and plural) article as text (die) and its example word. On bg 6:1 / 8.9:1, on surface 6.5:1 / 8.3:1.

tokens.name: die-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the DIE · FEMININE chip (die text on it 5.4:1 / 6.4:1).

tokens.name: das
tokens.usage: Neuter article as text (das) and its example word; also 'Example sentences and forms are ready' and 'Dictionary article applied'. Teal, not green, so it is never taken for the lime accent. On bg 5.6:1 / 10.9:1.

tokens.name: das-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the DAS · NEUTER chip and of the 'Dictionary article applied' strip (das text on it 5.3:1 / 7.6:1).

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque Variable", "DM Sans Variable", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One big number per screen: Home's deck total, Summary's knew count. Always followed by a 17px muted unit.

styles.name: display-word
styles.usage: The word on Word detail, the flashcard front's translation, Done's headline. The card back uses the same style at 48px.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Page largeTitle: My words, Practice, Import, Review, Session done.

styles.name: label-big
styles.usage: The label of Home's big lime action.

styles.name: meaning
styles.usage: The translation on Word detail, under the MEANING label.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Small header title, the drop zone's title, the count in a source card.

styles.name: cta
styles.usage: The big footer button (ui.cta) and the swipe stamps.

styles.name: letter
styles.usage: Letter section headings in My words, in muted; also the day headings of its Newest first view (Today, Yesterday, 13 Oct).

styles.name: example
styles.sample: Ich habe gestern einen Anruf bekommen.
styles.usage: An example sentence (Word detail, card back); the word itself bold, underlined 2px, in its gender colour.

styles.name: headword
styles.usage: A headword in a row: My words, Review, Summary. Its article at 600 in the gender colour.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: A card's title (source option), the sheet title, a confirmation's question.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons (700 on large secondary buttons), inputs and the status select (16px minimum on every control, or iOS Safari zooms).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 1 skipped; they won't be suggested again.
styles.usage: Running text, banners, empty states, the example's translation, toasts.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Translations under a headword, descriptions, tab labels (600), photo status.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: History lines, help text, stat labels, the swipe help line (12px), the credit footer.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels inside cards (MEANING, EXAMPLE, NOTE, YOUR TRANSLATION, NAME THIS IMPORT, NAME); ui.label in code. 13px with 0.06em for the gender chip.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: The NEW pill and count pills (count pills: no letter-spacing, tabular numerals).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every screen (--gutter in code).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Segmented control inner padding and tab gap; streak dot gap; results-bar gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between Review cards; inline icon-to-text gap (6px for small).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked footer buttons and the three answer buttons.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Grid gap of tiles and photo tiles; gap between source cards.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between Word detail cards; inside a list row between text and mark.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between blocks on a screen (Page main).

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Inner gap of a hero card (deck, results); padding of tiles and form cards.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between Home sections; padding of content cards (20px 22px).

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Padding of hero cards (deck, results, Word detail top: 24px 22px 22px).

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap around Done's result; drop-zone padding; tile inner gap.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Plain buttons (ui.button), segmented tabs, Retry/Retake, Use das, small icon wells.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Small controls: 44px icon wells, the status select, swipe stamps (--radius in code).

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs, the search field, the segmented control's track, photo thumbnails, Keep/Delete.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large secondary buttons (56px), Delete word, the 'already in your words' card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The big footer button (cta), answer buttons, Review cards.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Photo tiles and the Add more photos cell; the 64px empty-state icon.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles (ui.card), banners, form cards, source cards.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: The one hero block per screen: Home's deck card and big action, Word detail's top card, Summary's results, the drop zone.

tokens.name: radius-face
tokens.usage: The flashcard and its swipe outline.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, count pills, progress bars, the Cancel/Save pills (ui.pill), select pills (SelectPill), Review's Add/Skip state.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Toasts only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The flashcard only: the one object you pick up and throw. Every other card is flat (border, no shadow).
